EP27:E2 1300-3200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Shaken, Breathless]: "This ring..."

EP27:E4 3400-5800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Urgent, Demanding]: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
EP27:E5 5800-9400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.
EP27:E6 6400-9300 JULIANA [Hesitant, Sincere]: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
EP27:E7 9400-13200 CAMERA: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.
EP27:E8 9700-12800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Incredulous, Intense]: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
EP27:E9 13200-16800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.
EP27:E10 13400-16400 JULIANA [Earnest, Defending]: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
EP27:E11 16800-21600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.
EP27:E12 17200-21200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Trembling, Revelatory]: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
EP27:E13 21600-26100 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.
EP27:E14 21800-25800 JULIANA [Confused, Gentle]: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."

EP27:E16 26600-31400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Emotionally Strained, Weeping]: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
EP27:E17 31800-34900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.
EP27:E18 32100-34800 JULIANA [Shocked, Breathless]: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
EP27:E19 34900-37400 CAMERA: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.
EP27:E20 35200-37600 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Desperate, Clinging]: "My lost son wore that ring!"
EP27:E21 37400-40400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.
EP27:E22 37800-40200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [O.S.) (Pleading]: "Did your husband serve beside him?"
EP27:E23 41000-44200 JULIANA [Soft, Reverent]: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
EP27:E24 44200-46400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.
EP27:E25 44500-46400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Hushed, Desperate]: "What is your husband's name?"

EP27:E46 75200-77800 LADY CATHERINE [Mocking, Condescending]: "Medicine? You are a new maid."

EP27:E48 78100-80500 LADY CATHERINE [Incredulous, Accusing]: "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"

EP27:E75 118700-119800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Whispering, Dangerous]: "Poison."
